summary: Preserve Flash model identity across Tillm fallback

delivery.outcome: Provider-qualified simple-task model ids retain their model family through the Koru to Tillm adapter and the pilot reports effective routing evidence.

architecture.decision: Normalize only the provider prefix at the Koru adapter boundary; retain the original requested model in Koru routing receipts and let Tillm apply its existing provider fallback to the same model family.
architecture.rollback: Remove the adapter normalization and the pilot drop-in; the pre-change Tillm delegation remains available.

validation.evidence: The adapter passes the bare Flash model family to Tillm while Koru policy retains the provider-qualified receipt.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src pytest -q tests/test_tillm_bridge.py tests/test_task_model_policy.py tests/test_model_history.py tests/test_dashboard_logs.py
validation.evidence: Focused bridge, routing, history and dashboard regressions pass.
The deployed process exposes the Flash selector and an effective model or sanitized provider rejection reason.
